notice: Design metadata only. This file is not consumed by the worker and grants no execution or evidence-promotion authority. Existing-profile entries refer to existing approved templates; every new experiment needs its own reviewed exact protocol, adapter, input identities and pilot.

defaults.retry_policy: Infrastructure interruption only; never retry a semantic disagreement to replace it.
defaults.resource_policy: Retain current one-CPU, 2 GiB, zero-swap, 128-task service envelope. If pilot cannot fit, block and separately review changes; no automatic increase.
defaults.evidence_policy: Keep raw evidence private, retain every planned case and attempt, distinguish execution/comparison/hypothesis, require independent pre/post review; never auto-promote.

regression.status: Existing profile limits; regression is three jobs.

structural.status: Proposed ceiling; pilot and adapter review required.

oracle.status: Proposed ceiling; requires chunking and real case-completion progress.

reference.status: Proposed admission ceiling, not a feasibility estimate. Block if raw evidence cannot fit.

browser.status: Proposed; actual browser must fit the existing host/service envelope.

experiments.title: Existing RNG parity baseline
experiments.question: Does the accepted native/WASM corpus still reproduce its retained exact identity?
inputs: Pinned synthetic corpus, native binary, WASM binary, Node and runner
experiments.case_matrix: One frozen corpus; use the existing regression profile, which also runs LAB-002 and LAB-003.
experiments.evidence: 75,952 bytes, both output hashes, four defect-control counts, exact comparison.
experiments.controls: All four existing discriminating controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Qualified sampled synthetic CRT/small-bound scope only; no whole-game seeding claim.

experiments.title: Existing original instruction baseline
experiments.question: Does the retained original R10 instruction corpus still reproduce its receipt?
inputs: Pinned official executable, retained image/heap, qualified oracle interpreter
experiments.case_matrix: Existing eleven successful calls and four censored probes, unchanged.
experiments.evidence: Exact oracle receipt, twelve controls, continuation and censored denominator.
experiments.controls: Existing twelve defective models.
experiments.claim_limit: Retained two-record slot-zero domain only; censored probes are not rejection parity.

experiments.title: Existing Bosman endpoint baseline
experiments.question: Does the qualified Bosman platform reproduce its internal same-save endpoint?
inputs: Pinned qualified Bosman deployment, clean input tree, request/config
experiments.case_matrix: Classic, seed 1, fixed clock, fourteen days, normal/again; unchanged.
experiments.evidence: Supervisor endpoint, save identities, input/tool identities and complete attempts.
experiments.controls: Existing admission and supervisor endpoint checks; no new control capability claimed.
experiments.claim_limit: Internal Bosman replay only; original-process comparison remains not-run.

experiments.title: Existing squad set completeness
experiments.question: Do reciprocal complete list candidates equal an independent full staff-table inverse association?
inputs: Exact admitted retained image/heap
experiments.case_matrix: All fifty list slots and every staff record; existing six controls.
experiments.evidence: List/inverse/intersection differences, exclusion counts and set hashes.
experiments.controls: Unaligned link, wrong ID, short record, dropped member, duplicate member, changed backpointer.
experiments.claim_limit: 43 candidates and seven list anomalies are structural observations; no eligibility or lifetime admission.

experiments.title: Account for every squad-list anomaly
experiments.question: Can two independent decoders account identically for all fifty slots, including the seven anomalies?
inputs: Same retained image/heap as LAB-004; independent parser source
experiments.case_matrix: Exactly fifty slot rows plus full-table inverse scan; classify all links by capture coverage, alignment, stable ID and reciprocal links.
experiments.evidence: Private ordered slot ledger, independent parser agreement, each exclusion reason, 61 association denominator and residual unknowns.
experiments.controls: Positive complete-record fixture; unaligned pointer, duplicate, bad ID, missing extent, foreign club, and dropped slot mutations.
experiments.claim_limit: Classifications do not name invalid values as sentinels or foreign associations as loans.

experiments.title: Map actual member-list consumers
experiments.question: Which checks do bounded original call sites apply before counting or assigning a member?
inputs: Pinned official PE, Capstone, static R10 receipt and retained private slot ledger
experiments.case_matrix: Two already identified code regions: 0090d429..0090d45b and 0076263b..0076267d; bounded call-target inventory only.
experiments.evidence: Instruction-range hashes, exact branches/reads, call edges and unresolved entry/exit paths.
experiments.controls: Known instruction facts as positive controls; changed specimen byte, branch target and signedness as negative controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Static predicates do not prove whole-call behaviour or explain anomaly lifecycle.

experiments.title: Extend retained assignment/readback matrix
experiments.question: Within the retained zero-cache ordinary-club domain, what do slot position and operation order change?
inputs: Exact retained state, official instructions and the same two independently admitted member identities
experiments.case_matrix: Candidate frozen matrix: 20 slots x 2 members x 3 sequences (assign/read; repeat/read; A-to-B/read) = 120 cases; reset to the same state per case.
experiments.evidence: Full before/after image and heap hashes, ordered writes, ABI/EAX, mapping readback, untouched regions and RNG state where captured.
experiments.controls: Known slot-zero positive case; wrong row stride, signed-byte conversion, missing write and extra write defective models.
experiments.claim_limit: Other slots require new protocol review; no original UI, eligibility, swap, nonzero-cache or national-club claim.

experiments.title: Checkpoint continuation of command sequences
experiments.question: Does complete emulated checkpoint restoration preserve the exact next transitions?
inputs: Qualified LAB-007 oracle, complete mapped memory and emulator register state
experiments.case_matrix: One frozen eight-command sequence; seven internal split points x two fresh replays = fourteen paired cases.
experiments.evidence: Uninterrupted/restored ordered effects, all captured state and endpoint identities at each split.
experiments.controls: Omit one mapping write, change a register and drop a captured mutable region; each must discriminate.
experiments.claim_limit: Emulator continuation only; not original save-file compatibility or Rust implementation parity.

experiments.title: RNG boundaries and state consumption
experiments.question: Does original-instruction/native/WASM equality hold at signed bounds and table-wrap boundaries inside the admitted domain?
inputs: Official instruction oracle, pinned synthetic table, parameterized native/WASM corpus adapter
experiments.evidence: Return and every exposed state field after each call, exact bytes and all three backend identities.
experiments.controls: Zero must preserve state; defective wrap, signed remainder and extra-CRT-draw models.
experiments.claim_limit: No wider words/offsets, x87 large bounds or OS-time seeding.

experiments.title: Tactical selection branch corpus
experiments.question: Can the already qualified tactical-selection and effective-plan branches be replayed through the lab without scope drift?
inputs: Existing qualified registry/producer/effective-plan scripts and their exact admitted captures/receipts
experiments.case_matrix: Wrap existing frozen cases only; inventory every script/case before freezing; at most eight logical jobs.
experiments.evidence: Exact existing receipt comparison, branch/case denominator, controls and continuation.
experiments.controls: Existing script controls plus wrong receipt/schema rejection.
experiments.claim_limit: Adapter work broadens lab automation, not admitted behaviour; option-3 nonempty paths stay unknown.

experiments.title: Qualify complete reference capture
experiments.question: Can a qualified reference route capture complete linked records and their provenance reproducibly?
inputs: Reviewed capture backend, exact official specimen/data identity or separately identified Bosman route
experiments.case_matrix: Three captures from one identical frozen start; deterministic region list fixed before execution.
experiments.evidence: Region coverage, nonoverlap, full linked extents, raw hashes, endpoint/save identity and exact backend lineage.
experiments.controls: Missing region, overlap, changed input and truncated record rejection; paired uninstrumented endpoint.
experiments.claim_limit: R5 sparse captures lack player coverage; equal snapshots alone do not prove object lifetime or original parity.

experiments.title: Member lifecycle across original transitions
experiments.question: When do candidate membership links become valid, change club, or disappear during a real transition?
inputs: Qualified command/advance/capture route, complete before/after state and identified original consumers
experiments.case_matrix: At most four separately reset cases: no-op; one day; one qualified removal; one qualified addition. Freeze exact commands only after capability qualification.
experiments.evidence: Stable IDs, allocation/lifetime evidence where available, ordered writes, all fifty slots before/after and consumer results.
experiments.controls: No-op stability and decoder mutation controls; baseline/instrumented endpoint comparison.
experiments.claim_limit: Uncaptured lifetime remains unknown; do not infer a transfer/loan meaning from pointer changes alone.

experiments.title: Repair clean-input consumption observation
experiments.question: Can a bounded observer prove which clean files are consumed without altering the endpoint?
inputs: Reviewed repair of failed R9b observer, frozen policy and identical clean tree
experiments.case_matrix: Four arms: baseline, observer-disabled, observer-enabled, repeated observer-enabled; same original qualified duration/seed only.
experiments.evidence: Complete trace counters/footer, forbidden syscall if any, opened/read/mapped file identities and paired endpoints.
experiments.controls: Intentionally truncated trace rejected; disabled observer endpoint equality; bounded known-read fixture.
experiments.claim_limit: SIGSYS/incomplete traces remain failed evidence; mere file presence is not consumption.

experiments.title: Qualify fresh-run seed reproducibility
experiments.question: For an expanded, separately qualified Bosman profile, do seed and fixed clock determine repeated fresh endpoints?
inputs: New reviewed Bosman seed adapter; pinned complete input consumption evidence
experiments.case_matrix: Seeds [1,2,3,4] x three fresh repeats, each fourteen days, fixed clock; twelve logical jobs.
experiments.evidence: Within-seed exact endpoint equality, between-seed differences, complete save hashes and resource metrics.
experiments.controls: Same-seed positive repeat; injected clock/seed mismatch admission controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Current production template admits seed 1 only; Bosman results still do not certify the original.

experiments.title: Daily world-state deltas
experiments.question: Which identified state fields change at each daily boundary, and in what order?
inputs: Qualified day-step reference adapter and independently validated semantic decoder
experiments.case_matrix: One start, seven daily steps, two independently reset repeats = fourteen day observations.
experiments.evidence: Date progression, ordered event/field deltas, untouched-field hashes, RNG capture coverage and unknown byte ranges.
experiments.controls: No-op snapshot; dropped event and reordered event mutations.
experiments.claim_limit: Undecoded byte changes remain unknown; date advance is not evidence of every subsystem running.

experiments.title: Original save/load continuation
experiments.question: Does loading an original save reproduce subsequent reference transitions exactly?
inputs: Qualified original save/load and state export; frozen seven-day command sequence
experiments.case_matrix: Save at day boundaries 0,1,3,6; compare each loaded suffix against uninterrupted run; four paired cases.
experiments.evidence: Raw saves and decoded state, complete continuation, RNG/scheduler capture gaps and precise first difference.
experiments.controls: Corrupt/truncate fixture rejection; omit a captured RNG/scheduler component in comparator controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Rust checkpoint equality and Bosman internal same-save equality do not establish original save compatibility.

experiments.title: Contract and transfer transaction boundaries
experiments.question: What exact command results and state writes occur at one qualified contract or transfer boundary?
inputs: Original command adapter, decoded contract/finance/ownership state, proven valid fixture
experiments.case_matrix: One rule boundary per protocol: below/at/above a reference-identified threshold x two reset repeats = six cases; use distinct fixtures/protocols for renewal, transfer and loan.
experiments.evidence: Acceptance/rejection, counteroffer if any, balances, obligations, ownership, dates and RNG consumed.
experiments.controls: No-command baseline; changed threshold, sign and omitted ledger-entry comparators.
experiments.claim_limit: Thresholds, loan rules and transfer deadlines are hypotheses until observed; no modern-rule import.

experiments.title: Training, condition and recovery
experiments.question: Does one identified training setting alter condition/development over a fixed interval?
inputs: Qualified training command, condition/attribute decoder and full RNG capture or explicitly limited pairing
experiments.case_matrix: Baseline vs one setting x eight predetermined start/RNG states x seven days = sixteen trajectories; freeze setting and states before execution.
experiments.evidence: Daily condition, injuries/development where decoded, paired differences, event/RNG order and all censored runs.
experiments.controls: No-setting-change paired repeat; swapped player and missing day comparator controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Eight states support exploratory paired observations only; no population balance claim or independent-sample assumption.

experiments.title: Detailed match determinism and tactics
experiments.question: Does a detailed match replay exactly, and what changes when one tactical command changes?
inputs: Qualified original detailed-match adapter, valid lineup, event decoder, complete initial state
experiments.case_matrix: Baseline vs one tactical setting x four fixed complete starting states x two repeats = sixteen matches.
experiments.evidence: Ordered events, score, substitutions, player condition/ratings, all writebacks and RNG consumption coverage.
experiments.controls: Same-input repeats; dropped/reordered event, wrong score and omitted writeback controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Causal comparison is conditional on captured state; four states cannot establish tactic strength.

experiments.title: Quick-match path and writeback
experiments.question: Which invariants and writebacks differ between identified detailed and quick result paths?
inputs: Independently qualified quick-match and detailed-match routes; valid equivalent starting fixtures
experiments.case_matrix: Two paths x four frozen starting states x two repeats = sixteen matches.
experiments.evidence: Path selection, each path's reproducibility, scores/event availability, table/player/finance writes and missing exports.
experiments.controls: Wrong-path detection; missing table update and duplicate appearance-count controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Do not require identical scores across different algorithms or infer quick-path parity from detailed matches.

experiments.title: Competition ordering and tie-break rules
experiments.question: Which original ordering rule resolves a specific competition-table tie?
inputs: One identified 2001 competition, qualified standings routine or original valid states
experiments.case_matrix: Up to eight witnessed/valid tie scenarios selected to distinguish candidate rules, each repeated once; sixteen cases.
experiments.evidence: Input records, compared fields/order, final ranks and branches; every unresolved tie retained.
experiments.controls: Deliberately reversed comparison and omitted tie-break defective models.
experiments.claim_limit: No fabricated live league states; synthetic oracle states labelled separately; one competition does not generalize.

experiments.title: Season rollover and population lifecycle
experiments.question: Which persistent changes occur across one identified season boundary?
inputs: Qualified advance/save continuation, decoded calendar, competition and person identifiers
experiments.case_matrix: Two independently reset valid pre-boundary states x seven-day window; bounded daily checkpoints.
experiments.evidence: Promotion/relegation, scheduled fixtures, contract dates, retirement/new identities where decoded, history and unresolved deltas.
experiments.controls: No-boundary window; dropped entity, duplicate fixture and missing history controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Two windows do not qualify a whole season, every nation, or regeneration semantics.

experiments.title: Scouting information and news consequences
experiments.question: What visible knowledge and follow-up state change after one scouting action or inbox response?
inputs: Qualified original commands, visibility/message decoder and valid reference-created fixtures
experiments.case_matrix: Two separate subprotocols: no-action/action x two valid fixtures x two repeats; sixteen cases total.
experiments.evidence: Known/hidden fields, message identity/date, response availability, scheduled consequences and full state deltas.
experiments.controls: No-action repeat; leaking hidden field and dropping scheduled consequence controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Reports and messages may expose presentation only; hidden attributes or causal effects require explicit evidence.

experiments.title: Rust/native/browser evidence bridge
experiments.question: For each subsequently admitted behaviour, do Rust native and actual browser execution preserve the reviewed contract and saved continuation?
inputs: Reviewed behaviour contract, implemented Rust command/save profile, actual browser driver, original evidence receipt
experiments.case_matrix: For the first admitted slice: same frozen command corpus native/WASM; two fresh browser sessions with close/reopen; retain existing profile regressions.
experiments.evidence: Exact canonical state, save bytes, continuation, UI command/result receipts and rejected-input cases.
experiments.controls: Wrong command, stale save, altered field and failed persistence controls.
experiments.claim_limit: Existing v1-v5 checks can be wrapped separately; new squad behaviour remains gated on original admission and separate implementation.
